products.name: Classic Butter Croissant
products.shortDescription: Crisp, golden honeycomb layers with a delicate, tender crumb baked fresh for morning service.
products.fullDescription: Our signature laminated viennoiserie crafted for a shattering crisp crust and deeply aromatic, airy interior layers. Best enjoyed warm from our morning counter.

products.name: Twice-Baked Almond Croissant
products.shortDescription: Filled with fragrant roasted almond frangipane, topped with toasted flaked almonds and a light dusting of icing sugar.
products.fullDescription: Infused with delicate syrup, generously filled with house-made almond cream, and baked a second time until caramelized around the edges.

products.name: Pain au Chocolat
products.shortDescription: Flaky golden pastry wrapped around two batons of rich dark chocolate.
products.fullDescription: A timeless patisserie staple pairing delicately crisp laminated dough with smooth dark chocolate batons.

products.name: Seasonal Raspberry & Vanilla Tartlet
products.shortDescription: Crisp sweet pâte sucrée shell filled with silky vanilla pastry cream and crowned with fresh raspberries.
products.fullDescription: Delicate individual fruit tart balancing bright, jewel-toned raspberries with smooth vanilla custard and a buttery shortcrust base.

products.name: Black Fig & Honey Mascarpone Tart
products.shortDescription: Ripe quartered figs, light mascarpone cream, and warm blossom honey in a golden crust.
products.fullDescription: Crafted to highlight seasonal orchard fruit on a bed of lightly whipped cream and crisp golden pastry.

products.name: Ivory Botanical Celebration Cake
products.shortDescription: Layered sponge cake finished in textured warm ivory buttercream with delicate botanical accents.
products.fullDescription: Designed for intimate gatherings and milestones. Available in classic vanilla bean, raspberry preserve, or rich chocolate ganache fillings. For multi-tier or bespoke event designs, please use our Custom Cake Inquiry form.

products.name: Fleur de Sel Dark Chocolate Cookie
products.shortDescription: Crisp edges and a soft, fudgy center studded with dark chocolate chunks and flaky sea salt.
products.fullDescription: Baked for a deeply rich cocoa profile with pools of melted dark chocolate and a finishing pinch of flaky sea salt.

products.name: Artisan Sea Salt Fudge Brownie
products.shortDescription: Glossy crackled top with a dense, velvety chocolate truffle interior.
products.fullDescription: Cut into generous squares with a delicate flaky top crust and rich chocolate center.

products.name: Herbed Gruyère & Caramelized Onion Danish
products.shortDescription: Flaky laminated pastry folded with slow-caramelized onions, aged Gruyère, and fresh thyme.
products.fullDescription: A warm savoury option from our morning ovens, balancing crisp buttery pastry layers with rich cheese and sweet onions.
